one_line: SEO/AEO platform whose REST API exposes keyword research, backlinks, domain analysis, site audits and AI-visibility data at scale.
auth_notes: API key generated in the SE Ranking account (Settings > API tab), sent as a header/param on REST calls; API access included in every plan; no first-party SDKs (use REST reference + Postman collection).
self_serve_notes: Free trial (no credit card) includes API access; thereafter API comes with any paid plan (Core $129/mo, Growth $279/mo), API Add-On from $149/mo, or pay-as-you-go from a $50 deposit.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Data API (Keyword Research, Backlinks, Domain Analysis, SERP, Website Audit, AI Visibility) plus Project API (rank tracking, keyword grouping, competitor and AI tracking); up to 10 requests/second
api_surface.webhook_note: No webhook support mentioned in the docs; results are pulled on demand

existing_mcp.note: Official SE Ranking MCP server documented on the fetched page ('Explore MCP Server', query data inside Claude/Codex/Cursor); 1-minute setup

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms API key from account settings, REST via Postman collection, Data + Project API layers, official MCP server, pricing and free trial

agent_notes: Simple API-key auth, free trial available; the main cost is the paid plan. Official MCP server is a bonus. No webhooks.
